claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship City of Liverpool (Br), Hatfield, Liverpool, 46 days,
with mdse, to Hewlett & Torrance. From 12th to 25th April
had very heavy weather. May 15, lat 40 56, lon 65, spoke
ship Rapid, from Liverpool for New York, 39 days out.
